title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Strawberry Watermelon Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Watermelon combines juicy, sun-ripened Strawberry with sweet, fresh Watermelon for a bright and uplifting fruit blend. The flavour stays smooth and sweet from inhale to exhale with a light, refreshing edge. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod and an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No bottles or refilling required—just connect to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Dual mesh coil design ensures steady flavour and vapour delivery for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
